answer.answer: Northstar did not remove policy checks; they were renamed. The Northstar 4 migration guide states that Northstar 4 renames policy checks to release guards and that their purpose is unchanged (northstar-policy-new). This is consistent with the older documentation, which shows that Northstar 3 called pre-deployment controls policy checks (northstar-policy-old). Both snapshots belong to the same documentation lineage (lineage_id: northstar-policy-doc, subject_id: northstar), so the Northstar 4 snapshot represents the current state and supersedes the Northstar 3 terminology. Conclusion: the controls persist under a new name (release guards); no removal is documented in the supplied sources.
